Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class FavoriteService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.FavoriteService
public class FavoriteService extends Object
Manages per-user job favorites in favorites.json.

Each row maps a userId to a jobId. Used by the TA job browser to highlight starred postings and sort favorites first. Idempotent add/remove operations.
